A **rogue access point** is an unauthorized wireless AP installed on a secure network without explicit authorization from the network administrator. Attackers often set up rogue APs to mimic legitimate company Wi-Fi networks, tricking users into connecting and potentially capturing sensitive data.

A **rogue access point** is an unauthorized wireless AP installed on a secure network without explicit authorization from the network administrator. Attackers often set up rogue APs to mimic legitimate company Wi-Fi networks, tricking users into connecting and potentially capturing sensitive data.
